title: Battle of Deligrad
text: The Battle of Deligrad was fought between Serbian revolutionaries and an army of the Ottoman Empire, and took place on 3 September 1806 during the First Serbian Uprising. A 55,000-strong Ottoman army commanded by Albanian Pasha of Scutari Ibrahim Pasha was defeated with heavy casualties and the loss of nine guns by Grand Vozhd Karađorđe Petrović's 37,000 Serbian rebels at Deligrad in Serbia.
